unit.title: School Life & Schedules: Ordinals, Subjects, and Time

lesson.title: Opinions About Classes: Interesante and Aburrido, With Reasons
lesson.subject: spanish

contentBlocks.text: You can read a schedule and say which class comes first. Today you say what you think of them. Two words carry most opinions about school: interesante and aburrido. One of them agrees the way last week's adjectives did; the other one does not. Learning which is which is today's grammar.

[[interesante]] — interesting — ends in -e. Remember inteligente from last week? interesante works the same way: it does not change for gender at all.

- un proyecto interesante
- una clase interesante

Exact same word for both. It changes only for number, adding -s:

- las clases interesantes
- unos libros interesantes

So there is no 'interesanta' and no 'interesanto' — those are not Spanish words.

[[aburrido]] — boring — ends in -o, so it agrees exactly like serio and ordenado from last week:

- el libro es aburrido
- la película es aburrida
- los videos son aburridos
- las clases son aburridas

Watch the subjects that are already plural: las matemáticas and las ciencias are feminine plural, so they take son and the -as ending — las matemáticas son aburridas, not 'es aburrida.'

aburrido has two meanings, and the verb in front of it decides which one:

- La clase es aburrida. — The class is boring. (a trait of the class)
- Estoy aburrido. / Estoy aburrida. — I am bored. (how I feel right now)

es aburrido describes the thing; estoy aburrido describes your feeling in the moment. You will study that es / estoy split fully in a later week. For now, this week you only produce the es aburrido / es aburrida form — describing the class. Just recognize estoy aburrido when you hear it: it means someone is bored, not that they are boring.

An opinion is stronger with a reason. Use these frames:

- Para mí, la clase de arte es interesante porque dibujamos mucho.
- Creo que la historia es un poco aburrida porque hay demasiada tarea.
- En mi opinión, las ciencias son interesantes porque hacemos experimentos.

Reason starters: porque aprendo mucho, porque el profesor explica bien, porque es fácil, porque es difícil, porque hay mucha tarea, porque no me gusta leer.

Now trade opinions with a partner. Keep it going:

- A: ¿Qué materia es interesante para ti?
- B: Para mí, las ciencias son interesantes porque hacemos experimentos. ¿Y para ti?
- A: Creo que la historia es un poco aburrida, pero el arte es muy interesante.

Every turn is an agreement check: interesante stays the same, aburrido matches its subject.

You can give an opinion about any class and back it with a reason, keeping interesante invariable and aburrido agreeing. Tomorrow you add the clock: Tengo ciencias a las diez — saying exactly when each class meets.

El libro de historia es un poco ___.
La película de la clase de inglés es ___.

objectives: Use interesante without changing it for gender (una clase interesante, un proyecto interesante) and add -s only for the plural (clases interesantes)
Make aburrido agree in gender and number with its subject, including with the plural subjects las matemáticas and las ciencias (son aburridas)
Exchange opinions about school subjects with a reason, using Para mí / Creo que / En mi opinión + porque
materialsNeeded: Device for the cloze activity (optional — can be done orally)
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Recall inteligente and gris from last week — the adjectives that do not change for gender. interesante joins that group.
2. Teach interesante: same for un/una, -s for plural. Write the two non-words 'interesanta' and 'interesanto' on the board and cross them out.
3. Teach aburrido as an -o adjective, agreeing like serio. Drill the four forms, then the tricky plural subjects: las matemáticas son aburridas.
4. Teach the meaning note: La clase es aburrida (boring) vs. Estoy aburrido (bored). This week they only produce the 'es aburrido/a' form; recognition only for 'estoy aburrido.'
5. Model the opinion frames with reasons. Each student says one true opinion about a class.
6. Run the partner exchange; coach the endings live.
7. Complete the cloze activity, then the worksheet.
8. Preview tomorrow: telling time with class subjects.
differentiationTips: Struggling: give the subject already chosen ('La clase de música es ___') so only the ending is left to decide; start with singular subjects before las matemáticas / las ciencias
Ready for more: have them write a four-line opinion exchange where one speaker uses interesante twice and the other uses aburrido with two different subjects, all agreeing
If a child says 'las matemáticas es aburrida,' point to the subject: 'How many? What gender? Then the verb is son and the ending is -as.'
teacherGuide.answerKey: interesante: same for masculine and feminine (un/una ... interesante); plural adds -s (interesantes); 'interesanta'/'interesanto' do not exist. aburrido: el libro es aburrido, la película es aburrida, los videos son aburridos, las clases / las matemáticas / las ciencias son aburridas. Meaning: es aburrido/a = boring (the thing); estoy aburrido/a = bored (the feeling) — recognition only this week. Cloze: 1. interesante, 2. aburridas, 3. aburrido, 4. interesantes, 5. aburrida.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Delivers the scope-and-sequence Day 3 design — an opinion exchange, '¿Qué materia es interesante? ¿Aburrida?' with reasons — as an interpersonal task inside the week's WA-WL-2015.1.2 arc. It also does the week's central grammar contrast: interesante (invariable -e adjective, extending last week's inteligente/gris) against aburrido (agreeing -o adjective), and flags the ser/estar meaning shift in aburrido as recognition-only ahead of week 13's ser vs. estar.

generationData.instructions: Give opinions about school subjects. Keep interesante the same for gender; make aburrido agree with its subject.

rows.problem: Write the correct form: 'una clase ___ (interesting)', 'un proyecto ___ (interesting)', 'dos clases ___ (interesting)'.
Write the correct form of aburrido: 'el video es ___', 'la clase es ___', 'las matemáticas son ___'.
What is the difference in meaning between 'La clase es aburrida' and 'Estoy aburrido'?
Write two opinion sentences about your own classes: one with interesante and one with aburrido, each with a 'porque' reason.
